description: Piper Colt mounted as a gate guard at the entrance to Lakatamia Airfield. It wears the registration 5B-ICR; the underlying identity is reported as 5B-CAJ, construction number 22-8014, though the spottingmode administrator notes this attribution is not fully settled. Confirmed present on 3 October 2025 and visible on Esri imagery beside the airfield approach road.
